The '''''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier''', also known as the '''''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruiser''', or simply the '''''Quasar''-class carrier''' or the '''Imperial light carrier''', was a [[starship]] line built by the [[SoroSuub Corporation]]. It saw service in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy]], both as a [[starfighter]] [[carrier]] and a mobile base of operations.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Quasar-Fire-I.png|thumb|left|250px|A ''Quasar Fire I''-class Cruiser-Carrier firing its weapons]]
The ''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier<ref name="DB" /> was built by the [[SoroSuub Corporation]],<ref name="Encyclopedia Starfighters" /> a [[Sullust]]-based shipwright corporation.<ref name="Battlefront Planets">{{EA|subdomain=starwars|url=starwars/battlefront/planets|text=''Star Wars'' Battlefront Planets|nolive=1}}</ref> Its triangular structure made it similar to other dagger-shaped [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Starship|spacecraft]], including [[Star Destroyer]]s. Unlike Star Destroyers, however the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] was located at the frontal point and the [[hangar]]s at the base.<ref name="Homecoming" /> The structural integrity of the Quasar Fire spaceframe was questionable, being subject to micro-fractures while reverting from [[hyperspace]] to [[realspace]]. This much was alleged by a report issued by [[Mid-Rim Shipwrights]].<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>

The ''Quasar Fire''-class was 340 [[meter]]s in length.<ref name="Ships">{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the Empire and the Rebellion}}</ref> The four hangar bays had space to accommodate up to 48 [[starfighter]]s,<ref name="Rebel Files" /> however, some Imperial light carriers operated with as few as ten [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE/sa bombers]] and four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s.<ref name="Homecoming" /> The Empire used such carriers in [[orbit]] of occupied [[planet]]s, allowing for easy dispatch of fighters whenever necessary.<ref name="DB" /> The Empire deployed two different variants of the Quasar Fire: the [[Quasar Fire I-class Cruiser-Carrier|''Quasar Fire I''-class]] and the [[Quasar Fire II-class Cruiser-Carrier|''Quasar Fire II''-class]].<ref name="FFG II" />

==History==
One ''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier designated [[Imperial Cruiser 07200823]] was used at the [[Carida Academy]]. During [[Han Solo]]'s time as a [[Imperial cadet|cadet]] in the Academy, he and several other [[cadet]]s were assigned to [[pilot]] the cruiser, transporting [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilots]] for a training run.<ref name="Imperial Cadet 3">[[Han Solo - Imperial Cadet 3|''Han Solo - Imperial Cadet'' 3]]</ref>

[[File:Quasar-Fire-II.png|thumb|right|250px|A ''Quasar Fire II''-class Cruiser-Carrier with TIE/D and TIE/IN escorts]]
In the [[Standard year|year]] [[3 BBY]],<ref name="Homecoming date">According to {{SW|url=news/star-wars-rebels-returns-with-princess-leia|text=''Star Wars Rebels'' Returns...with Princess Leia}}, "[[A Princess on Lothal]]" is set around three [[Standard year|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[3 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. Because ''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' states the events of "[[The Mystery of Chopper Base]]" occur three years before the [[Battle of Yavin]], it takes place in 3 BBY. Since "Homecoming," is between these two episodes, the events of the episode must also take place in 3 BBY.</ref> the [[Spectres]], alongside [[Cham Syndulla]] of the [[Free Ryloth Movement]], [[Mission to Ryloth (Phoenix Squadron)|stole]] a ''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier in orbit of [[Ryloth]] for the rebellion. Imperial forces nearby had moved to retake control of the ship, sending TIEs and a landing craft to board the ship, though this effort was thwarted by the rebels shooting down all opposition with the ship's point defense cannons. They would later succeed in destroying the escorting [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class cruiser]] over [[Ryloth]] before escaping.<ref name="Homecoming" />

The stolen ship became the flagship of [[Phoenix Cell]] of the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early rebellion]], rechristened the ''[[Phoenix Nest]]'', housing their [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]s, and even being repainted to show its new affiliation.<ref name="Homecoming" /> After coming under [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (3 BBY)|attack]] by Imperial forces, the starship fled with the rest of the rebel fleet to the planet [[Atollon]].<ref name="The Forgotten Droid">{{Rebels|The Forgotten Droid}}</ref> After the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], it became part of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]], with [[Colonel]] [[Anj Zavor]] recommending to [[Mon Mothma]] the procurement of more escort carriers from the Empire.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> However, the ''Phoenix Nest'' was destroyed at the [[Battle of Atollon]], sacrificed by its commander, [[Jun Sato]] as it rammed on [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine|Konstantine's]] [[Kassius Konstantine's Interdictor|''Interdictor''-class]] [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|heavy cruiser]] to let [[Ezra Bridger]] in the [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport|''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport]] ''[[Nightbrother (Gauntlet fighter)|Nightbrother]]'' to escape [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]]'s [[blockade]] and get [[Clan Wren|reinforcements]].<ref name="Zero Hour" /> During the early rebellion, one ''Quasar Fire''-class was destroyed by a pair of [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvettes]] around the orbit of a celestial terrestrial body.<ref name="Dawn">''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]''</ref>

[[File:SquallUnderAttack-SWM.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Squall'' comes under attack from a squadron of A-wing interceptors.]]
At least one ''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier was present at the Rebel Alliance's [[Mako-Ta Space Docks]]. After the surviving ships escaped the Empire's [[Battle of Mako-Ta|attack]] on the base, [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] used the cruiser-carrier to rescue [[Han Solo]] and [[R2-D2]], who were trapped in a damaged [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|X-wing]]. Once Solo was aboard, the cruiser-carrier escaped to the [[moon]] [[Corosi 7]], but was too damaged to make more than one hyperspace jump, so the rebels used it to land on [[Nar Shaddaa]] and find passage aboard the ''[[Volt Cobra]]'', the ship of [[Sana Starros]].<ref name="Star Wars 55" />

At some point in the Galactic Civil War, the Imperial ''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier ''[[Squall]]'' came under attack by a squadron of Rebel [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]s. It was defended by a squadron of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE/sa bombers]].<ref name="Squall">{{Armada|set=Imperial Light Carrier Expansion Pack|cardname=''Squall''}}</ref> Also at some point during the reign of the Empire, the ''[[Pursuant]]'' and the ''[[Stronghold]]'' were in service in the Imperial Navy.<ref name="Pursuant">{{Armada|set=Imperial Light Carrier Expansion Pack|cardname=''Pursuant''}}</ref><ref name="Stronghold">{{Armada|set=Imperial Light Carrier Expansion Pack|cardname=Stronghold}}</ref>

After the [[Battle of Endor]], one ''Quasar Fire''-class is orbiting on the planet of [[Mon Cala]] to [[Scouring of Mon Cala|hit-and-fade strikes]] by Admiral [[Rae Sloane]] to lure the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] away from the [[Nadiri Dockyards]] to attack [[Project Starhawk]].<ref name="Squadrons">''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]''</ref> 

Following the battle of Endor, the elite [[204th Imperial Fighter Wing]], nicknamed Shadow Wing, used the ''Quasar''-class cruiser ''[[Aerie]]'' in several missions such as the [[Attack on the Hellion's Dare|attack]] on the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Hellion's Dare]]'' where it pursued the frigate through the [[Oridol Cluster]]. While the ''Aerie'' was damaged during the engagement, the ''Hellion's Dare'' was destroyed and the ''Aerie'' was able to retreat and would later be repaired.<ref name="Alphabet Squadron">[[Alphabet Squadron (novel)|''Alphabet Squadron'']]</ref> A year later in [[5 ABY]], the ''Aerie'' was present at the planet [[Jarbanov]] where Shadow Wing [[Operation at Jarbanov|attacked]] a [[Jarbanov colony|colony]] due to its support for the [[New Republic Defense Force]]. Later it was present in the [[Cerberon system]] in the [[Deep Core]] where it participated in a [[Cerberon system campaign|major campaign]] against New Republic forces there.<ref name="Shadow Fall">''[[Shadow Fall: An Alphabet Squadron Novel]]''</ref>

During the [[New Republic]]'s [[Defense of Kuat|siege]] of the [[Kuat Drive Yards]], [[Blade Squadron]] attacked and destroyed a light carrier during the final stages of the battle.<ref name="Kuat">{{InsiderCite|168|Blade Squadron: Kuat}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
First appearing in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[Homecoming]]," the ''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier was first officially named in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]]. The ship originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel ''[[The Truce at Bakura]]'', published in [[1994]], as the [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruiser/escort carrier]] and was first depicted visually in the Legends video game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']].
